=== FINAL test_andes_sim_f7.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# F7 contract: `run --mode fast` -- QEMU-only, transparent passthrough.
# Three layers:
#
#   1. run-test (unit, fast): passthrough_argv fills the qemu `standalone`
#      invoke template ({bin}/{elf}) and appends the post-`--` engine args
#      verbatim -- including a `-gdb tcp::N -S` gdbstub. Pure, no spawn.
#   2. CLI error paths (no engine needed): missing --mode, unknown model,
#      missing ELF, an extra positional, and engine!=qemu each exit 2 with a
#      clear message.
#   3. real passthrough (needs built qemu + a fixture): launch
#      `run --mode fast ELF -- -gdb tcp::PORT -S`; the gdbstub port opens and
#      qemu halts at reset -- the done-when "port opens, halts, debugger
#      connects". exec_passthrough's exit-code propagation is already covered
#      by the F5 infra test (and observed here only indirectly).
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"

BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
RUNTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-run-test"

bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"

# 1. unit: the argv-assembly contract carries the passthrough behavior
[ -x "$RUNTEST" ] || fail "missing unit-test binary: $RUNTEST"
"$RUNTEST" || fail "run unit tests (passthrough_argv) failed"

# assert `$BIN run ...` exits with $1 and its combined output matches regex $2
expect_rc_match() {
  local want_rc="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
  local out rc
  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq "$want_rc" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want_rc for [$*]: $out"
  echo "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "output missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
}

# 2. CLI error paths (deterministic; no qemu)
expect_rc_match 2 'mode .* is required.*--help' "$BIN" run
expect_rc_match 2 "unknown model 'bogus'"    "$BIN" run --mode bogus p.elf
expect_rc_match 2 'missing ELF.*workload'     "$BIN" run --mode fast
expect_rc_match 2 'engine args go after --'  "$BIN" run --mode fast a.elf b.elf
expect_rc_match 2 "engine must be 'qemu64' or 'qemu32'" "$BIN" run --mode fast --engine vsim:x p.elf

# 3. real passthrough: a frozen-at-reset gdbstub port opens (guarded on artifacts)
QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64}"
ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf"
if [ -x "$QEMU" ] && [ -f "$ELF" ]; then
  PORT=$(( 40000 + (RANDOM % 20000) ))
  BG=""
  cleanup() { [ -n "${BG:-}" ] && kill "$BG" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "tcp::$PORT" 2>/dev/null; true; }
  trap cleanup EXIT
  # -S halts the cpu at reset, so the stub listens regardless of the ELF body.
  "$BIN" run --mode fast "$ELF" -- -gdb "tcp::$PORT" -S </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  BG=$!
  opened=0
  for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
    if timeout 1 bash -c ">/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$PORT" 2>/dev/null; then opened=1; break; fi
    sleep 0.25
  done
  cleanup; trap - EXIT; wait "$BG" 2>/dev/null
  [ "$opened" -eq 1 ] || fail "fast passthrough: gdbstub port $PORT never opened"
  echo "[ok] real fast passthrough: qemu gdbstub halted + listening on :$PORT"
else
  echo "[skip] real fast run: qemu and/or fixture not built ($QEMU / $ELF)"
fi

ok "F7 run --mode fast"

# andesim driver: a standalone C++20 executable.
#
# Intentionally minimal -- no Verilator, no SystemC, no QEMU, no fmt/spdlog.
# It depends only on the host C++ toolchain and the shared ABI header at
# include/hybrid/state_abi.h (consumed from F5 on for state-file reads).
#
# Build out-of-tree via scripts/build_driver.sh, which points
# CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY at the repo's build/ so the binary lands at
# build/andesim.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(andes_sim CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

add_executable(andesim
  main.cpp
  cli.cpp
  cmd_list.cpp
  cmd_doctor.cpp
  engine_registry.cpp
  process.cpp
)

# Shared ABI header lives at <repo>/include/hybrid/state_abi.h, two levels up.
target_include_directories(andesim PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
target_compile_options(andesim PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)

# Unit tests. Kept in the build tree (build/driver), not redirected to build/,

# linking only the scaffold helpers it exercises; the shared CHECK harness is

  set_target_properties(${_t} PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR})

+// Transparent passthrough -- the mechanism behind `run --model fast|accurate`.
+//
+// The framework parses only its selection flags; everything after `--` is the
+// engine's own CLI. passthrough_argv fills the engine's role invoke template
+// ({bin}/{elf}) and appends those verbatim args; run_passthrough then execs the
+// result with all three std streams inherited and no timeout, so an interactive
+// gdbstub, the QEMU monitor, or a semihosting console all work unchanged and
+// the user experiences one simulator.
+#ifndef ANDES_SIM_RUN_PASSTHROUGH_HPP
+#define ANDES_SIM_RUN_PASSTHROUGH_HPP
+
+#include <string>
+#include <vector>
+
+#include "engine_descriptor.hpp"
+
+namespace andes_sim {
+
+// Assemble the argv: fill `eng`'s `role` invoke template ({bin}/{elf}) then
+// append `passthrough` verbatim. On an unknown role or unknown placeholder,
+// sets `err` and returns {}. `elf` is substituted as-is; validating that a
+// positional was actually given is the caller's job.
+std::vector<std::string> passthrough_argv(
+    const EngineDescriptor& eng, const std::string& role, const std::string& elf,
+    const std::vector<std::string>& passthrough, std::string& err);
+
+// Build the argv (passthrough_argv) and exec it with stdin/stdout/stderr
+// inherited and no timeout. Returns the child exit code (128+signal if it was
+// signalled), or 2 with `err` set when the argv cannot be assembled.
+int run_passthrough(const EngineDescriptor& eng, const std::string& role,
+                    const std::string& elf,
+                    const std::vector<std::string>& passthrough,
+                    std::string& err);
+
+}  // namespace andes_sim
+
+#endif  // ANDES_SIM_RUN_PASSTHROUGH_HPP

+#include <vector>
+

+

+  EngineDescriptor d;
+  d.id = "qemu";
+  d.bin_path = "/q";
+  d.invoke.push_back(
+      {"standalone",
+       {"{bin}", "-machine", "andes_ae350", "-cpu", "andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512",
+        "-nographic", "-semihosting-config", "enable=on,target=native", "-bios",
+        "{elf}"}});
+  return d;
+}

+              const std::vector<std::string>& want, const char* label) {
+  CHECK(got.size() == want.size());
+  const size_t n = got.size() < want.size() ? got.size() : want.size();
+  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

+      std::fprintf(stderr, "  %s[%zu]: got '%s' want '%s'\n", label, i,

=== build_driver.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the andesim driver: driver/ -> build/andesim.
#
# Standalone C++20 target (no Verilator, SystemC, or QEMU). Depends only on
# the host C++ toolchain and the shared ABI header under include/. This is the
# bootstrap consumed by setup.sh and `andesim build --what driver` (wired in
# F14). Out-of-tree build under build/driver; the binary is redirected to
# build/andesim via CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
BUILD="$ROOT/build/driver"

cmake -S "$ROOT/driver" -B "$BUILD" \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY="$ROOT/build" \
  >/dev/null

cmake --build "$BUILD" -j"$(nproc)"

echo "built: $ROOT/build/andesim"
=== lib/log.sh ===
# Shared status printers for test scripts. Sourced (not executed).
#
#   fail <msg...>          -> "[FAIL] <msg>" on stderr, exit 1
#   ok   <msg...>          -> "[ok] <msg>" on stdout
#   expect <rc> <re> CMD.. -> run CMD, fail unless it exits <rc> and its
#                             combined output matches the <re> regex
#
# These patterns were duplicated byte-identically across many test scripts.
# Source via:   . "$SCRIPT_DIR/<rel>/lib/log.sh"

fail() { echo "[FAIL] $*" >&2; exit 1; }
ok()   { echo "[ok] $*"; }

expect() {
  local want="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
  local out rc
  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
  [ "$rc" -eq "$want" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want for [$*]: $out"
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
}

# Repo root, derived from this lib's own location (tests/lib/ -> ../..).
_LIB_ROOT=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)

# cfg_val KEY -> the value of KEY in the repo-root config.env ("" if absent).
# A lightweight read so a test runs without a prior `source ./setup.sh`.
cfg_val() { grep -oP "$1=\\K.*" "$_LIB_ROOT/config.env" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | head -1; }

# The external vsim build dir (the sim_* binaries), the way the driver resolves
# it: VSIM_BIN_DIR env, then config.env, then the legacy in-tree build dir.
vsim_bin_dir() {
  if [ -n "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"; return; fi
  local v; v=$(cfg_val VSIM_BIN_DIR)
  [ -n "$v" ] && printf '%s\n' "$v" || printf '%s\n' "$_LIB_ROOT/verilator/build"
}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# F7 contract: `run --mode fast` -- QEMU-only, transparent passthrough.
3	# Three layers:
4	#
5	#   1. run-test (unit, fast): passthrough_argv fills the qemu `standalone`
6	#      invoke template ({bin}/{elf}) and appends the post-`--` engine args
7	#      verbatim -- including a `-gdb tcp::N -S` gdbstub. Pure, no spawn.
8	#   2. CLI error paths (no engine needed): missing --mode, unknown model,
9	#      missing ELF, an extra positional, and engine!=qemu each exit 2 with a
10	#      clear message.
11	#   3. real passthrough (needs built qemu + a fixture): launch
12	#      `run --mode fast ELF -- -gdb tcp::PORT -S`; the gdbstub port opens and
13	#      qemu halts at reset -- the done-when "port opens, halts, debugger
14	#      connects". exec_passthrough's exit-code propagation is already covered
15	#      by the F5 infra test (and observed here only indirectly).
16	set -uo pipefail
17	
18	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
19	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
20	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
21	
22	BIN="$ROOT/build/andesim"
23	RUNTEST="$ROOT/build/driver/andesim-run-test"
24	
25	bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_driver.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail "build_driver.sh failed"
26	
27	# 1. unit: the argv-assembly contract carries the passthrough behavior
28	[ -x "$RUNTEST" ] || fail "missing unit-test binary: $RUNTEST"
29	"$RUNTEST" || fail "run unit tests (passthrough_argv) failed"
30	
31	# assert `$BIN run ...` exits with $1 and its combined output matches regex $2
32	expect_rc_match() {
33	  local want_rc="$1" re="$2"; shift 2
34	  local out rc
35	  out=$("$@" 2>&1 </dev/null); rc=$?
36	  [ "$rc" -eq "$want_rc" ] || fail "rc=$rc want $want_rc for [$*]: $out"
37	  echo "$out" | grep -Eq "$re" || fail "output missing /$re/ for [$*]: $out"
38	}
39	
40	# 2. CLI error paths (deterministic; no qemu)
41	expect_rc_match 2 'mode .* is required.*--help' "$BIN" run
42	expect_rc_match 2 "unknown model 'bogus'"    "$BIN" run --mode bogus p.elf
43	expect_rc_match 2 'missing ELF.*workload'     "$BIN" run --mode fast
44	expect_rc_match 2 'engine args go after --'  "$BIN" run --mode fast a.elf b.elf
45	expect_rc_match 2 "engine must be 'qemu64' or 'qemu32'" "$BIN" run --mode fast --engine vsim:x p.elf
46	
47	# 3. real passthrough: a frozen-at-reset gdbstub port opens (guarded on artifacts)
48	QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-$ROOT/build/qemu/qemu-system-riscv64}"
49	ELF="$ROOT/tests/fixtures/handoff_roundtrip.elf"
50	if [ -x "$QEMU" ] && [ -f "$ELF" ]; then
51	  PORT=$(( 40000 + (RANDOM % 20000) ))
52	  BG=""
53	  cleanup() { [ -n "${BG:-}" ] && kill "$BG" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "tcp::$PORT" 2>/dev/null; true; }
54	  trap cleanup EXIT
55	  # -S halts the cpu at reset, so the stub listens regardless of the ELF body.
56	  "$BIN" run --mode fast "$ELF" -- -gdb "tcp::$PORT" -S </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
57	  BG=$!
58	  opened=0
59	  for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
60	    if timeout 1 bash -c ">/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$PORT" 2>/dev/null; then opened=1; break; fi
61	    sleep 0.25
62	  done
63	  cleanup; trap - EXIT; wait "$BG" 2>/dev/null
64	  [ "$opened" -eq 1 ] || fail "fast passthrough: gdbstub port $PORT never opened"
65	  echo "[ok] real fast passthrough: qemu gdbstub halted + listening on :$PORT"
66	else

68	fi
